title: B2 yakuniy imtihon va sertifikat
goal_uz: Dars oxirida B2 grammatikasi, lug‘ati va to‘rtta ko‘nikmasini imtihon tartibida takrorlab, yakuniy imtihon testini topshirishga tayyor bo‘lasiz.

vocab.w: I am writing to complain about
I would be grateful if you could

vocab.uz: tez ko‘z yugurtirish va aniq ma’lumot izlash

scenes.title: B2 yakuniy imtihoniga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Bu B2 darajasining oxirgi darsi. Oldingi darsda imtihon strategiyasini ko‘rib chiqdik. Bugun butun darajani qisqa, tartibli takrorlaymiz: grammatika, lug‘at, o‘qish, tinglash, yozish va gapirish.
scenes.say: Welcome to your B2 final lesson. Today we review everything, practise like in a real exam, and prepare you for the certificate.
scenes.say_uz: B2 yakuniy darsiga xush kelibsiz. Bugun hamma narsani takrorlaymiz, imtihondagidek mashq qilamiz va sertifikatga tayyorlanamiz.

scenes.title: Imtihon va sertifikat talablari
scenes.say_native: B2 sertifikatini olish uchun darajaning yakuniy imtihon testini topshirasiz va uy vazifasini bajarasiz. Imtihon oltita ko‘nikmani sinaydi: grammatika, lug‘at, o‘qish, tinglash, yozish va gapirish.
scenes.say: The exam tests six skills: grammar, vocabulary, reading, listening, writing and speaking. Today we practise all six.
scenes.say_uz: Imtihon oltita ko‘nikmani sinaydi: grammatika, lug‘at, o‘qish, tinglash, yozish va gapirish. Bugun hammasini mashq qilamiz.

scenes.title: Imtihon strategiyasi
scenes.say_native: Strategiya oddiy. Birinchi: topshiriqning shartini oxirigacha o‘qing, chunki ko‘p xatolar shoshilishdan chiqadi. Ikkinchi: oson savollarni avval yeching, qiyinlarini keyinga qoldiring. Uchinchi: bo‘sh joy qoldirmang, test bo‘lsa eng mantiqiy variantni tanlang. To‘rtinchi: oxirgi ikki daqiqani tekshirishga ajrating, ayniqsa fe’l shakllari va artikllarni.
scenes.say: Read the instructions, do the easy items first, never leave a blank, and keep two minutes at the end to check your answers.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘rsatmani o‘qing, oson savollardan boshlang, bo‘sh qoldirmang va oxirgi ikki daqiqada tekshiring.

scenes.title: Zamonlar: qisqa xarita
board: Present perfect: since / for / ever / yet
Past perfect: before another past action

examples.t: I will have finished by June.

scenes.say_native: Zamonlarni vaqt belgisiga qarab tanlang. “Since 2019”, “for ten years” — present perfect, chunki holat hozirgacha davom etadi. “Yesterday”, “in 2020” — aniq tugagan vaqt, past simple. Ikki o‘tgan voqeadan oldingisi past perfect bilan aytiladi. “By next June” kabi kelajak muddati oldidan tugaydigan ish esa future perfect.
scenes.say: She has worked here since 2019. When I arrived, the film had already started. By June I will have finished the course.
scenes.say_uz: U 2019-yildan beri bu yerda ishlaydi. Men kelganimda film allaqachon boshlangan edi. Iyunga kelib kursni tugatgan bo‘laman.

scenes.title: Zamonlardagi odatiy xatolar
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p xato: “I live here since 2020”. O‘zbekcha “2020-yildan beri yashayman” deymiz, shuning uchun hozirgi zamonni qo‘yamiz. Inglizchada “since” bilan present perfect kerak. Ikkinchi xato: “know”, “like”, “understand” kabi holat fe’llari davomiy shaklda ishlatilmaydi, ya’ni “I am knowing” emas, “I know”. Uchinchisi: “if” dan keyin “will” kelmaydi.
scenes.say: I have lived here since 2020. I know him well. If I have time, I will call you.
scenes.say_uz: Men 2020-yildan beri shu yerda yashayman. Uni yaxshi bilaman. Vaqtim bo‘lsa, qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.

scenes.title: Mashq: zamonlar
board: 2. When I arrived, the film ___ (start) already.
3. By next year I ___ (finish) my degree.
4. If I ___ (know), I would tell you.
scenes.say_native: Qavs ichidagi fe’lni to‘g‘ri shaklga qo‘ying. Har bir gapda vaqt belgisiga qarang: since, already, by next year va if.
scenes.say: Complete the four sentences with the correct tense. Look at the time word in each one.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta gapni to‘g‘ri zamon bilan to‘ldiring. Har bir gapdagi vaqt so‘ziga qarang.

scenes.title: Javoblar: zamonlar
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “has worked”, chunki “since 2019” bor. Ikkinchi: “had already started”, film men kelishimdan oldin boshlangan. Uchinchi: “will have finished”, “by next year” — future perfect belgisi. To‘rtinchi: “knew”, bu ikkinchi turdagi shart gap, haqiqatga to‘g‘ri kelmaydigan holat, shuning uchun “if” dan keyin past simple keladi. To‘rttasini ham topgan bo‘lsangiz, ajoyib!
scenes.say: One: has worked. Two: had already started. Three: will have finished. Four: knew, because it is an unreal condition.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: has worked. Ikki: had already started. Uch: will have finished. To‘rt: knew, chunki bu xayoliy shart.

scenes.title: Shart gaplar va orzular
board: 0: If you heat ice, it melts.
1: If it rains, I will stay.
2: If I were you, I would go.
3: If I had known, I would have told you.

examples.t: If I were you, I would accept.
If she had studied, she would have passed.
I wish I had more time.

scenes.say_native: Shart gaplarning to‘rt turini eslang. Nol turi — umumiy haqiqat. Birinchi tur — real kelajak: if + hozirgi, will + fe’l. Ikkinchi tur — hozirgi xayoliy holat: if + past, would + fe’l, bunda “I were” ham to‘g‘ri. Uchinchi tur — o‘tgan zamondagi o‘zgarmas voqea: if + past perfect, would have + V3. Orzu uchun ham shu logika: “I wish I had more time” — hozirga afsus.
scenes.say: If I were you, I would accept the offer. If she had studied, she would have passed. I wish I had more time.
scenes.say_uz: Sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam, taklifni qabul qilardim. U o‘qiganida, o‘tgan bo‘lardi. Vaqtim ko‘proq bo‘lsa edi.

scenes.title: Shart gap va wish xatolari
board: ✗ If I would have money, I would buy it.
✓ If I had money, I would buy it.
✗ I wish I would have more time.
✓ I wish I had more time.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida “agar pulim bo‘lsa edi, sotib olardim” deymiz va “bo‘lardi” ni ikki joyga qo‘yishga moyil bo‘lamiz. Inglizchada “would” faqat natija qismida turadi, “if” dan keyin esa ham “would” ham “will” kelmaydi. “Wish” dan keyin ham xuddi shunday: hozirgi afsus uchun past simple, o‘tgan afsus uchun past perfect. “I wish I had gone” — borganimda edi.
scenes.say: If I had money, I would buy it. I wish I had more time. I wish I had gone to the party.
scenes.say_uz: Pulim bo‘lsa, sotib olardim. Vaqtim ko‘proq bo‘lsa edi. Ziyofatga borganimda edi.

scenes.title: Mashq: shart gaplar
board: 1. If she ___ (study), she would have passed.
2. If I ___ you, I would accept.
4. Unless you hurry, you ___ miss the train.
scenes.say_native: Bo‘sh joylarni to‘ldiring. Birinchi gapda natija “would have passed”, demak shart qismida past perfect kerak. Ikkinchida “be” ning maxsus shaklini eslang. Uchinchi gap kechagi voqea haqida afsus. To‘rtinchida “unless” ma’nosini o‘ylang.
scenes.say: Complete the four sentences. Think about which type of conditional each one is.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta gapni to‘ldiring. Har biri shart gapning qaysi turi ekanini o‘ylang.

scenes.title: Javoblar: shart gaplar
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “had studied”, uchinchi tur. Ikkinchi: “were”, “If I were you” — maslahat berishning tayyor qolipi. Uchinchi: “had left”, kecha ertaroq ketmaganimga afsus. To‘rtinchi: “will miss”, chunki “unless” — “if not” demak, va bu birinchi tur, real kelajak. “Unless” bilan hech qachon inkor qo‘shmaymiz, “unless you don’t hurry” deyilmaydi.
scenes.say: One: had studied. Two: were. Three: had left. Four: will, because unless means if not.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: had studied. Ikki: were. Uch: had left. To‘rt: will, chunki unless degani if not.

scenes.title: Majhul nisbat va ko‘chirma gap
board: Passive: be + V3 (The road is being repaired.)
have + object + V3 (I had my car repaired.)

examples.t: She told me she was tired.
He asked if I was ready.

scenes.say_native: Majhul nisbat: “be” va V3. Davomiy shakl ham bor: “is being repaired”. “Have something done” ishni boshqa kishi qilganini bildiradi. Ko‘chirma gapda zamon bir pog‘ona orqaga suriladi: “I’m tired” — “she said she was tired”. “Say” dan keyin odam kelmaydi, “tell” dan keyin esa kelishi shart. Savol ko‘chirilganda tartib oddiy gapniki bo‘ladi: “He asked where I lived.”
scenes.say: The road is being repaired. I had my car repaired. She said she was tired. He asked me where I lived.
scenes.say_uz: Yo‘l ta’mirlanmoqda. Mashinamni ta’mirlatdim. U charchaganini aytdi. U mendan qayerda yashashimni so‘radi.

scenes.title: Majhul va ko‘chirma gap xatolari
board: ✗ She said me she was tired.
✓ She told me she was tired.
✗ He asked me where did I live.
✓ He asked me where I lived.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato bor. “Said me” emas, “told me”. Ko‘chirma savolda ikkinchi darajali gap tartibi qo‘llanadi: “where I lived”, “did” kerak emas. Va uchinchisi: “happen” va “take place” kabi fe’llar majhul nisbatda ishlatilmaydi, ya’ni “The accident happened.” O‘zbek tilida “sodir bo‘ldi” majhul ko‘rinadi, inglizchada esa oddiy fe’l.
scenes.say: She told me she was tired. He asked me where I lived. The accident happened last night.
scenes.say_uz: U menga charchaganini aytdi. U mendan qayerda yashashimni so‘radi. Halokat kecha tunda sodir bo‘ldi.

scenes.title: Mashq: majhul va ko‘chirma
board: 1. “I’m tired,” she said. → She said she ...
2. “Where do you live?” he asked me. → He asked me ...
3. They are repairing the road. → The road ...
scenes.say_native: Gaplarni qayta yozing. Birinchisi va ikkinchisida zamonni bir pog‘ona orqaga suring, olmoshlarga ham e’tibor bering. Uchinchisini majhul nisbatga aylantiring, davomiy zamon saqlansin. To‘rtinchisida soch kesishni boshqa odam qilgan, shuni ifodalang.
scenes.say: Change the first two sentences to reported speech, the third to the passive, and complete the fourth with have something done.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi ikki gapni ko‘chirma gapga, uchinchisini majhul nisbatga aylantiring, to‘rtinchisini have something done bilan to‘ldiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar: majhul va ko‘chirma
board: 2. He asked me where I lived.
4. I had my hair cut yesterday.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “She said she was tired”. Ikkinchi: “He asked me where I lived”, “do” yo‘qoladi. Uchinchi: “The road is being repaired”, ya’ni “is being” va V3. To‘rtinchi: “I had my hair cut yesterday”, bu yerda “cut” uchala shaklida bir xil, lekin bu V3 ekanini bilib qo‘ying.
scenes.say: One: she said she was tired. Two: he asked me where I lived. Three: the road is being repaired. Four: I had my hair cut.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: she said she was tired. Ikki: he asked me where I lived. Uch: the road is being repaired. To‘rt: I had my hair cut.

scenes.title: Modal fe’llar va artikllar
board: a/an first mention · the known · zero for general
scenes.say_native: Modal fe’llar bilan taxmin qilamiz: “must be” — aniq ishonch, “can’t be” — deyarli imkonsiz. O‘tgan zamon uchun “should have” — qilish kerak edi, lekin qilmadim. “Needn’t have” — qildim, lekin shart emas ekan. Artiklda esa qoida shu: birinchi eslatilganda “a”, ikkinchi marta “the”, umumiy ma’noda ko‘plik va sanalmaydigan otlarda artikl yo‘q: “Life is short.”
scenes.say: She must be at home. You should have told me. We needn't have hurried. Life is short.
scenes.say_uz: U uyda bo‘lsa kerak. Menga aytishingiz kerak edi. Shoshilishimiz shart emas ekan. Hayot qisqa.

scenes.title: Modal va artikl xatolari
scenes.say_native: Modal fe’ldan keyin “to” qo‘yilmaydi: “must go”, “can swim”. O‘zbek tilida artikl yo‘q, shuning uchun kasbdan oldin “a” ni tushirib qoldiramiz: “He is a doctor”. Va yana: “advice”, “information”, “furniture” sanalmaydigan otlar, ular bilan “a” va ko‘plik “s” ishlatilmaydi. “Some advice”, “a piece of advice” deymiz.
scenes.say: I must go now. He is a doctor. I need some advice about furniture.
scenes.say_uz: Hozir ketishim kerak. U shifokor. Mebel haqida maslahat kerak.

scenes.title: Mashq: modal va artikl
board: 1. The lights are off. They ___ be at home.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta bo‘sh joyni to‘ldiring. Birinchisida chiroqlar o‘chiq, demak xulosa qanday? Ikkinchisida kechikkan maslahat. Uchinchisida butun dunyoda bitta narsa haqida gap ketyapti. To‘rtinchisida “advice” ning turini eslang.
scenes.say: Fill the four gaps with a modal, an article or a quantifier. Think about the situation in each sentence.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta bo‘sh joyni modal, artikl yoki miqdor so‘zi bilan to‘ldiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar: modal va artikl
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “can’t be at home”, chiroqlar o‘chiq, shuning uchun ular uyda emas deb o‘ylaymiz. Ikkinchi: “should have told me”. Uchinchi: “The moon”, chunki oy yagona, hammaga ma’lum. To‘rtinchi: “some advice”, chunki “advice” sanalmaydigan ot.
scenes.say: One: can't. Two: should. Three: the, because there is only one moon. Four: some, because advice is uncountable.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: can't. Ikki: should. Uch: the, chunki oy bitta. To‘rt: some, chunki advice sanalmaydi.

scenes.title: Lug‘at: so‘z yasash va birikmalar
scenes.say_native: B2 imtihonida so‘z yasash doim chiqadi. Qo‘shimchalarni biling: -ion, -ness, -ment ot yasaydi, -ive, -ful, -able sifat yasaydi, un-, dis-, im- inkor ma’no beradi. Ikkinchi muhim mavzu — birikmalar. Inglizchada “make” natija yoki yangi narsa uchun: “make a decision”, “make a mistake”. “Do” esa faoliyat uchun: “do homework”, “do the shopping”. Birikmalarni butun holda yodlang.
scenes.say: It was an unexpected and impressive result. I made a mistake, then I did my homework.
scenes.say_uz: Bu kutilmagan va ta’sirli natija edi. Men xato qildim, keyin uy vazifamni bajardim.

scenes.title: Lug‘atdagi tipik xatolar
board: ✗ I am boring. (I’m tired of it)
✓ I am bored. / The film is boring.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida “xato qilmoq” va “vazifa qilmoq” bir xil “qilmoq” bilan aytiladi, shuning uchun “do a mistake” degan xato paydo bo‘ladi. To‘g‘risi “make a mistake”. Ikkinchi tuzoq: “-ed” va “-ing” sifatlar. Siz zerikkan bo‘lsangiz “bored”, narsa zerikarli bo‘lsa “boring”. Uchinchisi: “people” sanaladi, shuning uchun “many people”.
scenes.say: I made a mistake. I am bored because the film is boring. Many people were there.
scenes.say_uz: Men xato qildim. Film zerikarli bo‘lgani uchun zerikdim. U yerda ko‘p odam bor edi.

scenes.title: Mashq: lug‘at
board: 4. The film was so ___ that I felt ___. (bore)
scenes.say_native: Birinchi va ikkinchi gapda so‘zni to‘g‘ri sifat shakliga o‘tkazing. Uchinchi qatorda “make” yoki “do” ni tanlang. To‘rtinchi gapda ikkita bo‘sh joy bor: biri filmni, biri sizning holatingizni bildiradi, shu farqni eslang.
scenes.say: Form the correct word in the first two sentences, choose make or do for the third, and complete the fourth with bore.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi ikkita gapda so‘z yasang, uchinchisida make yoki do ni tanlang, to‘rtinchisini bore bilan to‘ldiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar: lug‘at
board: 3. make a decision / do the shopping
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “impressive performance”, sifat kerak. Ikkinchi: “unexpected result”, “un-” inkor qo‘shimchasi. Uchinchi: “make a decision”, “do the shopping”. To‘rtinchi: “The film was so boring that I felt bored”, birinchisi filmning xususiyati, ikkinchisi sizning his-tuyg‘ungiz.
scenes.say: One: impressive. Two: unexpected. Three: make a decision, do the shopping. Four: boring, then bored.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: impressive. Ikki: unexpected. Uch: make a decision, do the shopping. To‘rt: boring, keyin bored.

scenes.title: Phrasal verb va noto‘g‘ri fe’llar

examples.t: She came up with an idea.
He has chosen a new job.

scenes.say_native: Phrasal verblar — fe’l va predlogning birikmasi, ma’nosi alohida. “Put off” — kechiktirish, “come up with” — g‘oya topish, “turn down” — rad etish, “give up” — taslim bo‘lish, “run out of” — tugab qolish. Noto‘g‘ri fe’llarni uch shaklda yodlang: choose, chose, chosen; bring, brought, brought; forget, forgot, forgotten; break, broke, broken. Imtihonda aynan shu shakllar tekshiriladi.
scenes.say: We put off the meeting. She came up with a great idea. He turned down the job.
scenes.say_uz: Yig‘ilishni kechiktirdik. U ajoyib g‘oya topdi. U ishni rad etdi.

scenes.title: Mashq: phrasal verb
board: 1. We had to ___ the meeting because of the storm.
3. They offered him the job, but he ___ it.
scenes.say_native: Mana to‘rtta gap. Birinchisida yig‘ilish bo‘lmadi, uni boshqa kunga surdik. Ikkinchisida kimdir yangi g‘oyani topdi. Uchinchisida odam taklifga rozi bo‘lmadi. To‘rtinchisida “has” dan keyin fe’lning uchinchi shakli turishi kerak.
scenes.say: Complete the four sentences with phrasal verbs: put off, came up with, turned down, and the past participle of choose.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta gapni phrasal verblar bilan to‘ldiring: put off, came up with, turned down va choose ning V3 shakli.

scenes.title: Javoblar: phrasal verb
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “put off the meeting”. Ikkinchi: “came up with a great idea”. Uchinchi: “turned down”, ya’ni taklifni rad etdi. To‘rtinchi: “has chosen”, bu uchinchi shakl.
scenes.say: One: put off. Two: came up with. Three: turned down. Four: chosen, the past participle.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: put off. Ikki: came up with. Uch: turned down. To‘rt: chosen, fe’lning uchinchi shakli.

scenes.title: O‘qish: strategiya
scenes.say_native: O‘qishda avval matnni tez ko‘rib chiqing — bu skimming, maqsad umumiy mazmunni tushunish. Keyin savolga javob topish uchun ism, raqam, sana izlang — bu scanning. “True / False / Not Given” topshirig‘ida: matn tasdiqlasa True, matn aksini aytsa False, matnda umuman yo‘q bo‘lsa Not Given. Not Given — bu False emas, bu “matn aytmagan”. O‘z fikringizni qo‘shmang.
scenes.say: First skim for the main idea. Then scan for numbers and names. True means the text says it. False means the text says the opposite. Not Given means the text does not say.
scenes.say_uz: Avval umumiy mazmunni toping, keyin raqam va ismlarni izlang. True: matn aytadi. False: matn aksini aytadi. Not Given: matnda yo‘q.

scenes.title: Mashq: o‘qish matni
board: Central Library opens at 8, one hour earlier
scenes.say_native: Matnni tinglang va to‘rtta gapni True, False yoki Not Given deb baholang. Bir: kutubxona ikki hafta yopiladi. Ikki: Markaziy kutubxona odatda soat to‘qqizda ochiladi. Uch: onlayn xizmatlar to‘xtaydi. To‘rt: ta’mirlash ko‘p pul talab qiladi.
scenes.say: The Riverside Library will close for repairs from the third to the seventeenth of March. Members can borrow books from the Central Library, which will open an hour earlier than usual, at eight. Online services will continue, but the children's section will reopen only in April. Decide: one, closed for two weeks. Two, Central normally opens at nine. Three, online services stop. Four, repairs cost a lot.
scenes.say_uz: Riverside kutubxonasi 3 martdan 17 martgacha ta’mir uchun yopiladi. A’zolar kitoblarni Markaziy kutubxonadan olishi mumkin, u odatdagidan bir soat erta, sakkizda ochiladi. Onlayn xizmatlar davom etadi, bolalar bo‘limi esa faqat aprelda ochiladi.

scenes.title: Javoblar: o‘qish
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: True, uchinchi martdan o‘n yettinchigacha — ikki hafta. Ikkinchi: True, sakkiz soat “bir soat erta” bo‘lsa, odatda to‘qqizda ochiladi. Uchinchi: False, matnda onlayn xizmatlar davom etadi deyilgan. To‘rtinchi: Not Given, ta’mirlash narxi haqida matnda hech narsa yo‘q.
scenes.say: One: true. Two: true. Three: false, online services continue. Four: not given, the text says nothing about cost.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: true. Ikki: true. Uch: false, onlayn xizmatlar davom etadi. To‘rt: not given, narx haqida gap yo‘q.

scenes.title: Tinglash: strategiya
board: Listen for corrections: actually, no, make that
scenes.say_native: Tinglashda eng muhim qoida: audio boshlanishidan oldin savollarni o‘qing va nimani izlashni oldindan taxmin qiling: raqammi, vaqtmi, joymi. Ikkinchi qoida: so‘zlovchilar fikrini o‘zgartiradi. “Actually”, “no, wait”, “make that” so‘zlari eshitilsa, yakuniy javob keyin keladi.
scenes.say: Read the questions first. Listen for words like actually and make that, because the speaker may change the answer.
scenes.say_uz: Avval savollarni o‘qing. Actually va make that kabi so‘zlarga quloq soling, chunki so‘zlovchi javobni o‘zgartirishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Dialog 1: chipta olish
board: Two tickets? Which train? How much? How to pay?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog temir yo‘l kassasida bo‘ladi. Diqqat bilan eshiting: mijoz fikrini o‘zgartiradi. Dialogdan keyin to‘rtta savolga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Customer: I'd like two tickets to Manchester for Friday afternoon. Clerk: There's a train at two forty-five and one at three thirty. Customer: The three thirty, please. Actually, make that three tickets, my brother is coming too. Clerk: That's forty-five pounds. Customer: Can I pay by card? Clerk: Of course.
scenes.say_uz: Mijoz: Juma kuni tushdan keyin Manchesterga ikkita chipta kerak. Kassir: 2:45 va 3:30 da poyezd bor. Mijoz: 3:30, iltimos. Aslida uchta chipta, akam ham boradi. Kassir: Qirq besh funt. Mijoz: Karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi? Kassir: Albatta.

scenes.title: Mashq: dialog 1 savollari
scenes.say_native: Dialogni yana bir marta eslang va javob bering. Birinchi: mijoz qaysi poyezdni tanladi? Ikkinchi: oxirida nechta chipta olindi? Uchinchi: narxi qancha? To‘rtinchi: qanday to‘laydi? Ikkinchi savolda aynan tuzoq bor, “make that” so‘ziga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Answer the four questions: which train, how many tickets in the end, how much, and how does he pay?
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta savolga javob bering: qaysi poyezd, oxirida nechta chipta, qancha pul va qanday to‘lov.

scenes.title: Javoblar: dialog 1
scenes.say_native: Poyezd — uch o‘ttiz. Chiptalar soni — uchta, chunki “make that three tickets” degan gap avvalgi “two” ni bekor qildi. Narxi — qirq besh funt. To‘lov — karta bilan. Yakuniy javob doim tuzatishdan keyin keladi.
scenes.say: Three thirty, three tickets, forty-five pounds, by card. The correction make that three tickets changes the answer.
scenes.say_uz: Soat 3:30, uchta chipta, qirq besh funt, karta bilan. Make that three tickets javobni o‘zgartiradi.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: ish joyida
board: Which day? Which room? What time? What to bring?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog — ikki hamkasb o‘rtasida. Yig‘ilish haqida gap ketadi. Yana tuzatishlarga quloq soling va to‘rtta savolga tayyor turing.
scenes.say: A: Did you get Mr Lee's email? B: Yes. The meeting has moved from Tuesday to Thursday. A: Same room? B: No, Room four is being painted, so we're in Room seven. A: What time? B: Ten o'clock, but please bring the sales report.
scenes.say_uz: A: Janob Lining xatini oldingizmi? B: Ha. Yig‘ilish seshanbadan payshanbaga ko‘chdi. A: Xona shumi? B: Yo‘q, to‘rtinchi xona bo‘yalyapti, shuning uchun yettinchida. A: Soat nechada? B: O‘nda, savdo hisobotini olib keling.

scenes.title: Mashq: dialog 2 savollari
scenes.say_native: Savollar: yig‘ilish endi qaysi kunda? Qaysi xonada? Soat nechada? Nimani olib kelish kerak?
scenes.say: Answer: which day is the meeting now, which room, what time, and what must they bring?
scenes.say_uz: Javob bering: yig‘ilish endi qaysi kun, qaysi xona, soat nechada va nima olib kelish kerak?

scenes.title: Javoblar: dialog 2
scenes.say_native: Kun — payshanba, chunki seshanbadan ko‘chdi. Xona — yettinchi, to‘rtinchi xona bo‘yalayotgani uchun. Soat — o‘n. Olib kelish kerak bo‘lgani — savdo hisoboti. E’tibor bering: dialogda “is being painted” — majhul davomiy zamon, siz uni bugun takrorlagan edingiz.
scenes.say: Thursday, Room seven, ten o'clock, the sales report. Notice the passive: is being painted.
scenes.say_uz: Payshanba, yettinchi xona, soat o‘n, savdo hisoboti. Majhul nisbatga e’tibor bering: is being painted.

scenes.title: Yozish mezonlari
scenes.say_native: Yozma ishingiz to‘rtta mezon bo‘yicha baholanadi. Birinchi: topshiriqni to‘liq bajardingizmi, barcha punktlarga javob berdingizmi. Ikkinchi: tuzilma, ya’ni xatboshilar va bog‘lovchilar: however, moreover, as a result. Uchinchi: so‘z va grammatika xilma-xilligi, masalan shart gap va majhul nisbat. To‘rtinchi: to‘g‘rilik. Va uslubga rioya qiling: rasmiy xatda qisqartma ishlatilmaydi.
scenes.say: Examiners look at four things: task achievement, organisation, range of language and accuracy. Match your register to the reader.
scenes.say_uz: Mezonlar to‘rtta: topshiriq, tuzilma, til xilma-xilligi va to‘g‘rilik. Uslubni o‘quvchiga moslang.

scenes.title: Namuna: shikoyat xati
board: I am writing to complain about ...
I would be grateful if you could ...
scenes.say_native: Mana rasmiy shikoyat xatining ixcham namunasi. Salomlashuv, yozish maqsadi, muammo, talab va xayrlashuv — hammasi o‘z joyida. “Yours faithfully” faqat ism noma’lum bo‘lganda, “Dear Sir or Madam” dan keyin ishlatiladi. Ism ma’lum bo‘lsa, “Dear Mr Brown” va “Yours sincerely”.
scenes.say: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to complain about the laptop I bought on the fifth of May. It stopped working after two days. I would be grateful if you could replace it or refund my money. Yours faithfully, A. Karimov.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli janob yoki xonim, men 5-mayda sotib olgan noutbukdan shikoyat qilish uchun yozyapman. U ikki kundan keyin ishlamay qoldi. Uni almashtirsangiz yoki pulni qaytarsangiz, minnatdor bo‘lardim. Hurmat bilan, A. Karimov.

scenes.title: Mashq: xat boshlanishi va yakuni
board: Use: I am writing to ... / I would be grateful if ...
scenes.say_native: Tasavvur qiling, internetdan buyurtma qilgan telefoningiz kech yetib keldi. Ikki gap ayting: birinchisi “I am writing to complain about...” bilan boshlansin, ikkinchisi “I would be grateful if you could...” bilan talab bildirsin. Gaplar rasmiy bo‘lsin, qisqartmasiz.
scenes.say: Imagine your phone arrived late. Say one opening sentence and one closing request in formal English.
scenes.say_uz: Telefoningiz kech kelgan deb tasavvur qiling. Rasmiy inglizchada ochuvchi gap va yakuniy iltimosni ayting.

scenes.title: Javob namunasi: xat
board: I am writing to complain about the late delivery of my phone.
I would be grateful if you could send it immediately or refund me.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna: “I am writing to complain about the late delivery of my phone.” Va yakun: “I would be grateful if you could send it immediately or refund my money.” Muhimi: “complain about”, “complain for” emas.
scenes.say: A model: I am writing to complain about the late delivery of my phone. I would be grateful if you could send it at once or refund my money.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna: Telefonimning kech yetkazilganidan shikoyat qilish uchun yozyapman. Uni darhol yuborsangiz yoki pulni qaytarsangiz, minnatdor bo‘lardim.

scenes.title: Gapirish mezonlari
board: Fillers: Well, let me think, as far as I know
scenes.say_native: Gapirishda ham to‘rtta narsa baholanadi: ravonlik, lug‘at, grammatika va talaffuz. Ravonlik mukammal gapirish degani emas, to‘xtab qolmaslik degani. To‘xtash kerak bo‘lsa, “Well, let me think” yoki “That’s an interesting question” kabi iboralardan foydalaning. Fikringizni sabab bilan asoslang, “because” va misol keltiring. Xato qilsangiz, “I mean...” deb o‘zingizni tuzating, bu ijobiy hisoblanadi.
scenes.say: Keep talking. If you need time, say: well, let me think. Give reasons and examples, and correct yourself calmly.
scenes.say_uz: Gapirishda to‘xtamang. Vaqt kerak bo‘lsa, well, let me think deng. Sabab va misol keltiring, o‘zingizni xotirjam tuzating.

scenes.title: Mashq: 20 soniya gapirish
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz gapirasiz. Oxirgi dam olishingiz haqida yigirma soniya gapiring. Uch narsa bo‘lsin: bitta taqqoslash, masalan “more relaxing than”, bitta shart gap, masalan “If I had more money, I would...”, va bitta sabab, “because” bilan. To‘xtamang, xato bo‘lsa, davom eting.
scenes.say: Talk for twenty seconds about your last holiday. Include one comparison, one conditional and one reason with because.
scenes.say_uz: Yigirma soniya oxirgi ta’tilingiz haqida gapiring: bitta taqqoslash, bitta shart gap va because bilan sabab.

scenes.title: Javob namunasi: gapirish
board: Last summer I went to Samarkand.
It was more relaxing than my previous trip.
If I had more money, I would stay longer.
I loved it because the food was amazing.
scenes.say_native: Mana bitta namuna: “Last summer I went to Samarkand. It was more relaxing than my previous trip because there were fewer tourists. If I had more money, I would have stayed longer.” Taqqoslash, sabab va uchinchi tur shart gap — hammasi bor, chunki gap o‘tgan safar haqida.
scenes.say: Last summer I went to Samarkand. It was more relaxing than my last trip because there were fewer tourists. If I had had more money, I would have stayed longer.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan yozda Samarqandga bordim. Oldingi safarimdan ko‘ra tinchroq edi, chunki turistlar kam edi. Pulim ko‘proq bo‘lganida, uzoqroq qolgan bo‘lardim.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: kuchsiz shakllar va urg‘u
scenes.say_native: Tabiiy inglizchada yordamchi so‘zlar kuchsiz aytiladi: “to” — /tə/, “of” — /əv/, “and” — /ən/, “can” — /kən/. Undosh bilan unli yonma-yon kelsa, ular birlashadi: “pick it up” — “pi-ki-tup”. Shuningdek, so‘z oilasida urg‘u siljiydi: “photograph” — birinchi bo‘g‘inda, “photography” — ikkinchisida, “photographic” — uchinchisida. Bu B2 imtihonida ham tinglashda, ham talaffuzda muhim.
scenes.say: I can swim, but I can't swim today. Pick it up. Photograph, photography, photographic.
scenes.say_uz: Men suza olaman, lekin bugun suza olmayman. Uni oling. Photograph, photography, photographic.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: o‘zingizni baholang
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq: B2 yo‘lingiz haqida yigirma soniya gapiring. Nimani endi qila olasiz, nima qiyin bo‘ldi va keyingi qadam qanday. Mana qolip: “Since I started B2, I have learned to...”, “The hardest thing was...”, “Next, I will...”.
scenes.say: Talk for twenty seconds about your B2 progress. Use: since I started, I have learned to; the hardest thing was; next, I will.
scenes.say_uz: B2 yutuqlaringiz haqida yigirma soniya gapiring: since I started, I have learned to; the hardest thing was; next, I will.

scenes.title: Namuna: B2 yutuqlari
board: Since I started B2, I have learned to give opinions.
Next, I will prepare for C1.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “Since I started B2, I have learned to give opinions and write formal emails. The hardest thing was the third conditional, but I have practised a lot. Next, I will move on to C1.” Bu aynan B2 darajasidagi nutq. Tabriklayman!
scenes.say: Since I started B2, I have learned to give opinions and write formal emails. The hardest thing was conditionals. Next, I will move on to C1.
scenes.say_uz: B2 ni boshlaganimdan beri fikr bildirishni va rasmiy xat yozishni o‘rgandim. Eng qiyini shart gaplar edi. Keyin C1 ga o‘taman.

scenes.title: B2 darajasi: yakuniy xulosa
board: Vocabulary: word formation, collocations, phrasal verbs
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Zamonlar va shart gaplarni vaqt belgisi bilan tanlaysiz. Majhul nisbat, ko‘chirma gap, modal fe’llar va artikllarni biladigan bo‘ldingiz. Lug‘atda so‘z yasash, birikmalar va phrasal verblar bor. O‘qishda Not Given ni ajratasiz, tinglashda tuzatishlarni ushlaysiz, yozishda uslubni saqlaysiz, gapirishda to‘xtamaysiz. Endi imtihon testiga o‘ting.
scenes.say: You can now choose tenses, build conditionals, use the passive, report speech, and handle all four skills. Go and take the exam.
scenes.say_uz: Endi zamonlarni tanlay olasiz, shart gap, majhul nisbat va ko‘chirma gap tuzasiz, to‘rtta ko‘nikmani boshqarasiz. Imtihonni topshiring.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: complete the B2 final exam
Goal: pass the exam and get the B2 certificate
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: B2 yakuniy imtihonini topshiring. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni — sayt belgilagan minimal natijaga erishish, shunda B2 sertifikatini olasiz. Xato qilgan joylaringizni oldindan takrorlang. Omad! Keyingi darsda B2 dan C1 ga: ilg‘or daraja yo‘l xaritasini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to complete the B2 final exam. Good luck, and congratulations on reaching this point.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz — B2 yakuniy imtihonini topshirish. Omad tilayman va shu bosqichga yetganingiz bilan tabriklayman.

homework_uz: B2 yakuniy imtihon testini topshiring. Mezon: sayt belgilagan minimal natijaga erishish va B2 sertifikatini olish; xato qilgan mavzularingizni imtihondan oldin qayta ko‘rib chiqing.

quiz.why_uz: “Since 2019” bilan present perfect ishlatiladi: has worked.
Ikki o‘tgan voqeadan oldingisi past perfect bilan: had already started.

quiz.q: If I ___ you, I would accept the offer.
quiz.why_uz: Ikkinchi tur shart gapda maslahat uchun: If I were you.

quiz.q: I wish I ___ more time yesterday.
quiz.why_uz: O‘tgan zamon afsusi uchun wish + past perfect: had had.

options: He asked me where did I live.
He asked me where I lived.
He said me where I lived.
He asked me where do I live.
quiz.why_uz: Ko‘chirma savolda oddiy gap tartibi: where I lived.
Hozirgi davomiy majhul nisbat: is being repaired.

quiz.q: The lights are off. They ___ be at home.
quiz.why_uz: Chiroq o‘chiq — uyda bo‘lishi mumkin emas: can't be.

quiz.q: You ___ told me earlier! Now it's too late.
The film was so ___ that I fell asleep.
We had to ___ the meeting because of the storm.
In a True / False / Not Given task the text does not mention the idea. The answer is:
quiz.why_uz: Matnda yo‘q bo‘lsa — Not Given, bu False degani emas.

quiz.q: Which word has the main stress on the third syllable?
